task_title: QA re-verification: file the tautological-snapshot and behind-workdir census gaps
task_criteria: The board gains two rows filed from re-run evidence at origin/main 9109975: the CF-099 drift probe's snapshot leg compares the plan's counts to the frozen tip it names so it PASSes a 7-row/16-event stale plan, and the publish-drift census grades an ancestor-HEAD workdir that is merely behind as lossy DRIFT with no repair path. Both rows carry falsifiable numbered acceptance criteria and the exact commands that demonstrated the gap.
